init_kaiming_normal: initialize a tensor with kaiming normal distribution for neural network weight initialization
init_xavier_uniform: initialize a tensor with xavier uniform distribution for balanced gradient flow
init_normal: initialize a tensor with values drawn from a normal distribution with given mean and std
init_zeros: initialize a tensor by setting all elements to zero for bias layers
make_crypten_compatible: wrap a torch.nn.init function to support Crypten tensor inputs alongside standard PyTorch tensors
